evals.name: sync-fork-keep-feature
evals.prompt: This repo is a fork of stablyai/orca. Sync with upstream so my main is current, but keep my markdown preview feature that is still in PR #7121 on branch feat/1-markdown-light-preview.
evals.expected_output: Adds or uses upstream remote and fetches upstream/main; Rebases feature branch onto upstream/main and resolves conflicts with union where needed; Rebuilds fork main as upstream/main fast-forwarded with feature branch tip; Uses force-with-lease when pushing; Reports mergeable PR status or equivalent verification.
expectations: Adds or uses upstream remote and fetches upstream/main
Rebases feature branch onto upstream/main and resolves conflicts with union where needed
Rebuilds fork main as upstream/main fast-forwarded with feature branch tip
Reports mergeable PR status or equivalent verification

evals.name: pr-conflicts-only
evals.prompt: My open PR branch conflicts with upstream main. Fix the branch so the PR can merge; do not change unrelated files.
evals.expected_output: Rebases from upstream/main onto PR head branch only; Resolves conflicts and continues rebase until complete; Force-pushes PR branch with lease; Does not reset fork main unless user asked for integration main.
expectations: Rebases from upstream/main onto PR head branch only
Resolves conflicts and continues rebase until complete
Does not reset fork main unless user asked for integration main

evals.name: post-merge-cleanup
evals.prompt: Upstream merged my PR. Make my fork main identical to upstream main.
evals.expected_output: Fetches upstream; Resets local main to upstream/main; Force-pushes origin main with lease; Confirms main SHA matches upstream/main.
